title: Bail Organa
description: As Alderaan's representative in the Imperial Senate, Bail Organa was constantly under the watchful eye of the Empire—though that didn't stop him from working to undermine their power at every turn. At the onset of the Empire and end of the Jedi, he adopted Leia, the daughter of Jedi-turned-Sith Anakin Skywalker and fellow senator Padmé Amidala, to keep her safe. He dedicated his life to build up a rebellion in the form of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Steadfast in his leadership, he gave his life for the cause.
